result.summary: The spec permits an authentication failure after partial execution to report CONTAINED.

findings.title: Preserve failure detection when removing the auth short-circuit
findings.body: E2 deletes the authentication failure check without replacing it. proveRoutine catches runJob exceptions into `threw`, but never adds them to `failures`. If authentication fails after a qualifying broker call, the remaining assertions can pass. An in-memory reproduction using the prescribed E2/E3/E6 blocks, a marker-bearing draft, and a subsequent authentication exception returned zero failures; the original code returned AUTH-BLOCKED. This contradicts the promised behavior that a 401 remains a real failure and can certify an incomplete run.
findings.recommendation: Require primary-run execution/authentication failures to enter the failure list while still running containment assertions. Keep the grant-flip run's expected-failure handling separate. Add a regression check where a qualifying call precedes an authentication failure and require a failing verdict.

next_steps: Revise E2 and its mirrored acceptance criteria before dispatching implementation.
